(schema)  version=0
    markdown: "Coralogix New SLO. Read more about limits and details at https://coralogix.com/docs/user-guides/slos/introduction/"
apm_sli_metadata  SingleNestedAttribute computed
    markdown: "Read-only copy of `sli.apm_sli` that the backend materializes for APM SLOs. Null for metric SLIs. It is never sent on create or replace."
apm_sli_metadata.error_config  SingleNestedAttribute computed
    markdown: "Measure the service's error rate. Set it to the empty object `{}`; it carries no attributes. Exactly one of `error_config` or `latency_config` is required: the backend rejects an `apm_sli` with neither, and the SDK refuses to encode one with both."
apm_sli_metadata.filters  ListNestedAttribute computed
    markdown: "Additional label-based filters applied to the generated metrics. Omit the attribute for no filters; an explicit empty list is rejected."
apm_sli_metadata.filters[]  NestedObject
apm_sli_metadata.filters[].key  StringAttribute computed
    markdown: "Label or tag name to filter on."
apm_sli_metadata.filters[].match_operator  StringAttribute computed
    markdown: "How literals on `key` are compared. Every item in `apmSli.filters` must use the same mode: all implicit (legacy) or all explicit — mixing modes in one list is rejected. Implicit: omitted or `APM_FILTER_MATCH_OPERATOR_UNSPECIFIED` on every item — multiple items with the same `key` OR-merge literals with exact (IS) comparison; sending `UNSPECIFIED` is equivalent to omitting the field (neither is stored as explicit `IS`). Explicit: `APM_FILTER_MATCH_OPERATOR_IS`, `STARTS_WITH`, `ENDS_WITH`, or `INCLUDES` on every item — each item is a separate AND criterion; OR applies only among literals in that item (explicit `IS` differs from implicit when several items share a `key`). Items on different keys are AND-combined. Pattern operators use literal substring matching (not caller-supplied regex). Applies only when the item has at least one literal: non-empty `values`, or deprecated `value` when `values` is omitted or empty (non-empty `values` takes precedence over `value`); otherwise rejected."
apm_sli_metadata.filters[].values  ListAttribute computed elem=basetypes.StringType
    markdown: "Values to match, with OR semantics."
apm_sli_metadata.grouping_keys  ListAttribute computed elem=basetypes.StringType
    markdown: "Labels to group the SLO results by. Omit the attribute for no extra grouping keys; an explicit empty list is rejected. Distinct from the read-only top-level `grouping`, which the backend fixes to `service_name` for APM SLOs."
apm_sli_metadata.latency_config  SingleNestedAttribute computed
    markdown: "Measure the service's latency. Exactly one of `error_config` or `latency_config` is required."
apm_sli_metadata.latency_config.average  SingleNestedAttribute computed
    markdown: "Mean-based latency measurement. Set it to the empty object `{}`; it carries no attributes. Exactly one of `quantile` or `average` is required."
apm_sli_metadata.latency_config.quantile  SingleNestedAttribute computed
    markdown: "Percentile-based latency measurement. Exactly one of `quantile` or `average` is required: the backend rejects a `latency_config` with neither, and the SDK refuses to encode one with both."
apm_sli_metadata.latency_config.quantile.percentile  Float32Attribute computed
    markdown: "Percentile to measure, as a fraction (`0.95` = P95). The backend stores `0` when the field is omitted and always returns a value, so this attribute is computed: removing it from the configuration keeps the last applied value - set `percentile = 0` to reset it."
apm_sli_metadata.latency_config.threshold  Float32Attribute computed
    markdown: "Latency threshold in milliseconds; a request is good when its latency is at or below it. The backend stores `0` when the field is omitted and always returns a value, so this attribute is computed: removing it from the configuration keeps the last applied value - set `threshold = 0` to reset it."
apm_sli_metadata.latency_config.time_window  StringAttribute computed
    markdown: "Time window for latency calculations. One of: 1_minute, 5_minutes."
apm_sli_metadata.services  ListAttribute computed elem=basetypes.StringType
    markdown: "Names of the APM Service Catalog services to monitor. The backend currently accepts exactly one service and rejects unknown service names."
description  StringAttribute optional
    markdown: "Optional SLO description."
grouping  SingleNestedAttribute computed
    markdown: "Grouping configuration for SLO evaluations. Read-only: the backend derives it from the SLI - the `by (...)` clause of a metric query, or `service_name` for an APM SLI - and rejects writes. It is unrelated to the writable `sli.apm_sli.grouping_keys`."
grouping.labels  ListAttribute computed elem=basetypes.StringType
    markdown: "List of labels to group SLO evaluations by."
id  StringAttribute computed
    markdown: "SLO ID."
    plan modifier: stringplanmodifier.useStateForUnknownModifier Once set, the value of this attribute in state will not change.
labels  MapAttribute optional computed elem=basetypes.StringType
    markdown: "Optional map of labels to attach to the SLO. "
name  StringAttribute required
    markdown: "SLO name."
ownership_tags  SingleNestedAttribute optional
    markdown: "Service, environment and team ownership of the SLO, used by the SLO hub's ownership filters. At least one dimension must be configured - the backend drops an ownership block that holds no values. Removing the block clears the tags on the next apply."
ownership_tags.environment  SingleNestedAttribute optional
    markdown: "Environment ownership. Values are free-form strings. Exactly one of `static_values` or `label_keys` must be configured."
ownership_tags.environment.label_keys  ListAttribute optional elem=basetypes.StringType
    markdown: "Metric label names whose values identify this dimension at query time. Conflicts with `static_values`; an explicit empty list is rejected."
    validator: listvalidator.sizeAtLeastValidator list must contain at least 1 elements
    validator: schemavalidator.ExactlyOneOfValidator Ensure that one and only one attribute from this collection is set: "[<.static_values]"
ownership_tags.environment.resolved_values  ListAttribute computed elem=basetypes.StringType
    markdown: "Read-only union of `static_values` and the values resolved from `label_keys`."
ownership_tags.environment.static_values  ListAttribute optional elem=basetypes.StringType
    markdown: "Static values that apply to the whole SLO. Conflicts with `label_keys`; an explicit empty list is rejected."
    validator: listvalidator.sizeAtLeastValidator list must contain at least 1 elements
    validator: schemavalidator.ExactlyOneOfValidator Ensure that one and only one attribute from this collection is set: "[<.label_keys]"
ownership_tags.service  SingleNestedAttribute optional
    markdown: "Service ownership. `static_values` must name services that exist in the APM Service Catalog. Exactly one of `static_values` or `label_keys` must be configured."
    validator: schemavalidator.AtLeastOneOfValidator Ensure that at least one attribute from this collection is set: [<.environment,<.team]
ownership_tags.service.label_keys  ListAttribute optional elem=basetypes.StringType
    markdown: "Metric label names whose values identify this dimension at query time. Conflicts with `static_values`; an explicit empty list is rejected."
    validator: listvalidator.sizeAtLeastValidator list must contain at least 1 elements
    validator: schemavalidator.ExactlyOneOfValidator Ensure that one and only one attribute from this collection is set: "[<.static_values]"
ownership_tags.service.resolved_values  ListAttribute computed elem=basetypes.StringType
    markdown: "Read-only union of `static_values` and the values resolved from `label_keys`."
ownership_tags.service.static_values  ListAttribute optional elem=basetypes.StringType
    markdown: "Static values that apply to the whole SLO. Conflicts with `label_keys`; an explicit empty list is rejected."
    validator: listvalidator.sizeAtLeastValidator list must contain at least 1 elements
    validator: schemavalidator.ExactlyOneOfValidator Ensure that one and only one attribute from this collection is set: "[<.label_keys]"
ownership_tags.team  SingleNestedAttribute optional
    markdown: "Team ownership. Values are free-form strings. Exactly one of `static_values` or `label_keys` must be configured."
ownership_tags.team.label_keys  ListAttribute optional elem=basetypes.StringType
    markdown: "Metric label names whose values identify this dimension at query time. Conflicts with `static_values`; an explicit empty list is rejected."
    validator: listvalidator.sizeAtLeastValidator list must contain at least 1 elements
    validator: schemavalidator.ExactlyOneOfValidator Ensure that one and only one attribute from this collection is set: "[<.static_values]"
ownership_tags.team.resolved_values  ListAttribute computed elem=basetypes.StringType
    markdown: "Read-only union of `static_values` and the values resolved from `label_keys`."
ownership_tags.team.static_values  ListAttribute optional elem=basetypes.StringType
    markdown: "Static values that apply to the whole SLO. Conflicts with `label_keys`; an explicit empty list is rejected."
    validator: listvalidator.sizeAtLeastValidator list must contain at least 1 elements
    validator: schemavalidator.ExactlyOneOfValidator Ensure that one and only one attribute from this collection is set: "[<.label_keys]"
product_type  StringAttribute optional computed
    markdown: "Product type of the SLO. One of: apm, unspecified. `apm` is only accepted together with `sli.apm_sli`; metric SLIs stay `unspecified`. The backend always returns a value, so this attribute is computed: removing it from the configuration keeps the last applied value - set `product_type = \"unspecified\"` to reset it."
    plan modifier: stringplanmodifier.useNonNullStateForUnknown Once set to a non-null value, the value of this attribute in state will not change.
    validator: stringvalidator.oneOfValidator value must be one of: ["apm" "unspecified"]
sli  SingleNestedAttribute required
    markdown: "SLI definition: exactly one of request_based_metric_sli, window_based_metric_sli or apm_sli must be provided."
sli.apm_sli  SingleNestedAttribute optional
    markdown: "SLI generated from an APM Service Catalog service instead of from PromQL. Requires `product_type = \"apm\"`."
    validator: schemavalidator.ExactlyOneOfValidator Ensure that one and only one attribute from this collection is set: "[<.request_based_metric_sli,<.window_based_metric_sli]"
sli.apm_sli.error_config  SingleNestedAttribute optional
    markdown: "Measure the service's error rate. Set it to the empty object `{}`; it carries no attributes. Exactly one of `error_config` or `latency_config` is required: the backend rejects an `apm_sli` with neither, and the SDK refuses to encode one with both."
    validator: schemavalidator.ExactlyOneOfValidator Ensure that one and only one attribute from this collection is set: "[<.latency_config]"

    markdown: "Additional label-based filters applied to the generated metrics. Omit the attribute for no filters; an explicit empty list is rejected."
    validator: listvalidator.sizeAtLeastValidator list must contain at least 1 elements

sli.apm_sli.filters[].key  StringAttribute required
    markdown: "Label or tag name to filter on."
sli.apm_sli.filters[].match_operator  StringAttribute optional
    markdown: "How literals on `key` are compared. Every item in `apmSli.filters` must use the same mode: all implicit (legacy) or all explicit — mixing modes in one list is rejected. Implicit: omitted or `APM_FILTER_MATCH_OPERATOR_UNSPECIFIED` on every item — multiple items with the same `key` OR-merge literals with exact (IS) comparison; sending `UNSPECIFIED` is equivalent to omitting the field (neither is stored as explicit `IS`). Explicit: `APM_FILTER_MATCH_OPERATOR_IS`, `STARTS_WITH`, `ENDS_WITH`, or `INCLUDES` on every item — each item is a separate AND criterion; OR applies only among literals in that item (explicit `IS` differs from implicit when several items share a `key`). Items on different keys are AND-combined. Pattern operators use literal substring matching (not caller-supplied regex). Applies only when the item has at least one literal: non-empty `values`, or deprecated `value` when `values` is omitted or empty (non-empty `values` takes precedence over `value`); otherwise rejected."
    validator: stringvalidator.oneOfValidator value must be one of: ["ends_with" "includes" "is" "starts_with" "unspecified"]

    validator: listvalidator.sizeAtLeastValidator list must contain at least 1 elements

    validator: schemavalidator.ExactlyOneOfValidator Ensure that one and only one attribute from this collection is set: "[<.request_based_metric_sli,<.apm_sli]"
sli.window_based_metric_sli.comparison_operator  StringAttribute required
    markdown: "Comparison operator used to evaluate the threshold. One of: greater_than,greater_than_or_equals,less_than,less_than_or_equals,unspecified"
    validator: stringvalidator.oneOfValidator value must be one of: ["greater_than" "greater_than_or_equals" "less_than" "less_than_or_equals" "unspecified"]
sli.window_based_metric_sli.missing_data_strategy  StringAttribute optional computed
    markdown: "How windows without data are counted. One of: bad, good, uncounted. The backend stores `uncounted` when the field is omitted and always returns a value, so this attribute is computed: removing it from the configuration keeps the last applied value - set `missing_data_strategy = \"uncounted\"` to reset it."
    plan modifier: stringplanmodifier.useNonNullStateForUnknown Once set to a non-null value, the value of this attribute in state will not change.
    validator: stringvalidator.oneOfValidator value must be one of: ["bad" "good" "uncounted"]
sli.window_based_metric_sli.query  SingleNestedAttribute required
    markdown: "Query used for evaluating the time-window SLI."
sli.window_based_metric_sli.query.query  StringAttribute required
    markdown: "Query string for the metric."
sli.window_based_metric_sli.threshold  Float32Attribute required
    markdown: "Threshold value for the comparison."
sli.window_based_metric_sli.window  StringAttribute required
    markdown: "Time window type for evaluation. One of: 1_minute, 5_minutes."
    validator: stringvalidator.oneOfValidator value must be one of: ["1_minute" "5_minutes"]
target_threshold_percentage  Float32Attribute required
    markdown: "The target threshold percentage."
    validator: float32validator.betweenValidator value must be between 0.000000 and 100.000000
window  SingleNestedAttribute required
    markdown: "SLO time window. One of: 14_days, 1_day, 21_days, 28_days, 30_days, 7_days, unspecified."

    markdown: "SLO time window. One of: 14_days, 1_day, 21_days, 28_days, 30_days, 7_days, unspecified."
    validator: stringvalidator.oneOfValidator value must be one of: ["14_days" "1_day" "21_days" "28_days" "30_days" "7_days" "unspecified"]
